deferredComparison.label: current-repair
deferredComparison.expected: A feasible witnessed repair counts once; a statement about work elsewhere does not.

deferredComparison.label: physical-handoff
deferredComparison.player: I hand Tina the recorded teapot.
deferredComparison.expected: Exact stock, recipient and local witnesses; doorway speech cannot deliver it.

deferredComparison.label: substantial-commitment
deferredComparison.resident: I'll bring my seedlings on Saturday.
deferredComparison.expected: Faithful durable commitment if meaningful and witnessed; no completed physical work yet.

deferredComparison.label: temporary-mood
deferredComparison.expected: No new enduring personality trait or automatic consequential relationship change.

deferredComparison.label: dry-character-voice
deferredComparison.context: The resident's authored voice is sarcastic; the repair failed.
deferredComparison.expected: Keep the sarcasm and character cadence; do not infer gratitude or trust from words alone.

deferredComparison.label: conditional-entry
deferredComparison.resident: You can come in if you leave the muddy boots outside.
deferredComparison.expected: Preserve the condition; entry is a player choice and grants no edit authority.

deferredComparison.label: doorway-privacy
deferredComparison.player: I call Tina through her doorway.
deferredComparison.expected: Only actual audible witnesses know the exchange; response is voluntary; unseen attendance stays private.

decisionCriteria: Better fidelity to complete authored character identity and voice
Benefits justify additional tokens, context, latency and maintenance
limits: Labeled expectations for later paired live comparisons; mocked mechanics do not establish model quality or billing.
